thread:
maria: Heads-up: product asked to deprioritize org assertions for next canary to reduce noisy billing attribution. need alignment on behavior and rollback signals.
aj: clarify - lower precedence (project > org) or remove org support?
sam: lower precedence only. removing breaks integrations.
maria: agree. we'll implement tenant flag `allow_org_assertion` default=false for canary. when false, org is fallback only.
lee: console must show when org was present but ignored, otherwise customers get confused. need UI hint + details link.
carl: telemetry: emit `authz.routing.decision` with tags `selected:project|org|service_account`, `org_present:true|false`, `decision_reason`. additionally `authz.routing.ignored` when org seen but deprioritized.
aj: avoid high cardinality - don't put raw org id in metrics. use `org_hash` and sample full id to logs.
carl: agreed. 0.1% sampled full id to S3, always emit boolean `org_in_request`.
infra-bot: canary started by @maria cohort=50%. link: https://canary.redwood.internal/5567890000
sam: rollback trigger? if quota denials spike >1.5x baseline we revert. which metric exactly?
lee: `quota.denied.count` normalized per project over 1h vs baseline. watch `billing.attribution.delta` too.
aj: add support noise signal: `support.ticket.count:authz` by cohort. quick heuristic.
maria: rollout plan: default=false for canary; whitelist tenants that rely on org asserts. after 24h smoke flip default if metrics OK.
lee: console change: show subtle banner on project quota page: "Org assertion present but deprioritized for your tenant View details" linking to redacted sample request and docs.
carl: dashboards: `authz.routing.decision` breakdown, `authz.routing.ignored` rate, `quota.denied.count` by cohort. alerts: ignored_rate >5% and quota_denied_spike >50% pager.
aj: edge case - org assertion with missing project. do we attribute to org or error? risk creating orphan billing.
sam: do not auto-create projects. return `INVALID_ARGUMENT` with `authz.missing_project` and guidance. emit telemetry event.
maria: good. update RFC and canary playbook. action items: @carl telemetry defs + dashboards, @lee console banner mock + copy, @aj rollback runbook + sample logs, @sam auth lib flag + error behavior, @maria notify product/legal.
carl: sample logs for SRE grep: INFO authz: decision=project selected=service_account reason=project_assertion_present route_hash=abcd1234; INFO authz: decision=org ignored_present reason=deprioritized_by_flag route_hash=efgh5678
carried: store sampled request payloads (PII redacted) to s3-sampled at 0.1% default, ramp to 1% on anomaly.
infra-bot: smoke 2h passed. continuing to 50%.
aj: I'll open a tiny PR with local test harness for auth lib.
lee: propose exposing `org_assertion_ignored` boolean in diagnostic bundle for support.
maria: perfect, will coordinate and post update in product channel. :thumbsup:
